dialogue.soulless.renegade.call: There you are. The one the old man gave the blade to.
dialogue.soulless.renegade.intro1: Don't recognise me? Of course not. The old man doesn't talk about me.
dialogue.soulless.renegade.intro2: I stood in that same dojo. Held that same stick. Only nothing worked for me, and he looked at me as if I wasn't there.
dialogue.soulless.renegade.intro3: And you he gave the blade. Just like that. Give it to me - or I take it.
dialogue.soulless.renegade.win: That's all? The blade won't save you.
dialogue.soulless.renegade.defeat1: No... No, it can't be. I trained. All those years...
dialogue.soulless.renegade.defeat2: This isn't over. And you know what? The old man will never tell you you're worth anything either. You'll remember me then.
dialogue.soulless.renegade.seize1: There. At last... What? It burns... It burns! It won't have me!
dialogue.soulless.renegade.seize2: Fine. Fine. I'll come to you in your sleep, %1$s. Every night. Until it's mine.
dialogue.soulless.renegade.dream_call: Asleep? I told you I'd come.
dialogue.soulless.renegade.again1: You again. Again that blade, obeying you and not me.
dialogue.soulless.renegade.again2: The old man can't help you here. No one can.
